unsupported_claims: The authors say they will continue future work under two main goals: (1) improving the method itself and (2) broadening its application.
Specifically, they aim to further optimize the model and training strategy, improve robustness and efficiency, and extend the approach to more complex or larger-scale scenarios.
They also mention exploring additional datasets/tasks and refining the method so it can be used more widely in practice.
rationale: The source paper instead says future work will focus on investigating the duality between language modeling and graph modeling, using the results to improve language modeling, and strengthening the theoretical justifications of the method.
